jonny-mobile.note: DONE + MERGED. Plugin follow-up complete. (1) TEST-INSTALL caught a runtime load failure that `claude plugin validate` missed: plugin.json's explicit "hooks": "./hooks/hooks.json" double-loaded the auto-loaded standard hooks file ('Duplicate hooks file detected' -> Status: failed to load). jonny-desktop.task: meristem MCP + skill development: add sprite rendering to the MCP (preview_sprite, compare_builds) so the authoring loop can actually SEE what it picked, flag typo'd config KEYS (currently silently ignored), and bring the pixel-art skill up to date with the tile wrap-safety and silhouette-distinctness standards
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED, awaiting merge. PR #6 (branch feat/mcp-sprite-preview, commit 32819d7), CI green ubuntu + windows py3.12, full suite 166 passed. Earlier PR #5 merged as b733750; stale humanoid-prop-layers branch deleted, remote now main only. Closed the biggest gap in the authoring surface: the pixel-art skill's core loop is render-then-judge-by-eye, but nothing in the MCP could produce a picture, so every defect found in #4/#5 came from a step the MCP could not do. Added meristem_generators.preview (pure functions: render_sprite, render_builds) plus MCP tools preview_sprite and compare_builds returning real ImageContent. Both render against the MANIFEST's style_contract - the same domain the compiler builds from, so a preview cannot show a different game than the build - report the gate verdict beside the picture, and REFUSE a descriptor whose build does not exist (a typo'd build renders the default, so previewing it would put a dog under the label griffon and read as confirmation). compare_builds defaults to silhouettes because interior detail hides outline collisions. Variant axis derived per archetype, not hardcoded to build - otherwise weapons (kind), pickups (shape) and tiles (name) would each render one default N times. Also fixed a silent-failure gap: config KEYS were never validated, so {shpae: heart} or British {hat_colour: ...} validated clean then rendered the default; check_sprite now returns warnings for them, deliberately warnings not errors because the legal-key set is derived and a bad derivation must not fail a manifest that renders correctly. The one hand-maintained piece (_ANIM_PARAMS) is guarded behaviourally, because the last hand-maintained table here (color_keys) rotted. Added public variant_options() rather than reading catalog's private _VARIANTS - the ProceduralGenerator._TILES lesson. spec-store now declares meristem-asset-gate; plugin README's standalone pip line was already broken for meristem-generators and is corrected. Skill updated with the #4/#5 standards: silhouette distinctness BETWEEN variants, byte-difference tests are not distinctness tests, tiles are a torus (wrap not clamp, periods divide, review 3x3), and a new section on validating a metric before trusting it listing the three discarded this week. Doctor gains a render check. Decision recorded as dec-014-8a77. RECOMMENDED NEXT: review and merge PR #6. Known follow-up deliberately NOT bundled and called out in the PR: key warnings reach check_sprite but not validate_all, which needs cross_reference's (errors, skipped) return shape widened - reusing checks_skipped would be a lie since a typo'd key is not a skipped check.

Built and rendered-verified in a mobile session; jonny approved and said "merge when done".
